content.title: Million Dollar Weekend: The Surprisingly Simple Way to Launch a 7-Figure Business in 48 Hours
content.text: The Instant Worldwide Bestseller I've built 8 businesses each worth +$1 million (Kickflip, Gambit, KingSumo, SendFox, Sumo, Tidycal, Monthly1K, AppSumo). And… most were started in a single weekend. You don't have to be rich, brilliant, or super experienced. The truth is, ordinary people start profitable businesses every single day. Step 2: Claim your Free Resources Buy the book from your favorite bookseller, then input your email here to receive the following bonuses… Bonus: Million Dollar Weekend Challenges Checklist Get an easy to follow checklist for all the challenges from the book to make executing your Million Dollar Weekend seamless as possible. Your Million Dollar Weekend Journal An in-depth companion to jot down business ideas, brainstorm unseen opportunities, and work through crucial startup napkin math. Idea Challenges to Help Create Profitable Ideas Four detailed strategies to generate million dollar ideas with a ton of examples, stories, and easy to apply frameworks. One-Minute Business Model Workbook How do you know if your idea is a million dollar opportunity? This useful workbook assesses the unit economics of a product or service to tell you. 6 Ways to Enhance Your Offering Six simple ways to transform your offer into one customers can't refuse (with plenty of case studies and real life examples). And much more. Download the First Chapter of Million Dollar Weekend (for FREE) Hear how I bounced back from getting fired from Facebook after being Employee #30, learn to make things happen SUPER quickly using NOW, Not How, and calculate your Freedom Number to help you quit your day job. Enter your email below to get the free chapter. 10 Things This Book Will Teach You Learn how to… Find your Freedom Number to make entrepreneurship risk-free Not spend a single cent before making your first $1 Generate +10 easy-to-validate ideas in 10 minutes Use a One Minute Business Model to ensure it's a million dollar opportunity Get customers excited to give you their money Use email to make a f*&k-ton of money Build a social media machine to scale to $1M and beyond Automate your business to make $$$ while you sleep Make time to run your business while living the life of your dreams Build courage to overcome procrastination and have fun! … and much, much more. By Monday, you could be an entrepreneur with a profitable business on the path to seven figures. Give me 48 hours and I'll change your life. "Noah is an animal! Absolutely fearless. I've never met anyone faster at going from idea to first sale." Tom BilyeuFounder of Quest Nutrition and host of the show Impact Theory "I admire Noah. This guy has put in the hard work for many years and I've watched him stay relevant and put up wins time again. I continue to cheer for him!"
